title: Peak hardware FLOPS vs DRAM and interconnect bandwidth growth (Gholami et al.)

extraction.method: Rendered p.1 at 400 dpi; calibrated y from horizontal gridlines (1 at row 449, 100 at 308, 1e4 at 168, 1e6 at 27 in crop; 70.35 px/decade) and x from annual vertical gridlines (45.65 px/yr, 1997 at col 187, 2023 at col 1374); dot centroids from colour segmentation. Not yet cross-checked, so points_verified stays false until compared with agent A.

caveats: Gholami does not say which DRAM products form the 1.6x line; the DRAM series mixes GDDR3-5 and HBM generations in the plot.
Caption says normalised to R10000 'as used to report cost of training LeNet-5' (1998); the R10000 dot sits at ~1997 on the x axis.
Paper's 20-year window: x axis 1996-2023 shown; fit lines span roughly 1997-2022.
Unlabelled dots (about 20 compute, 5 DRAM, 3 interconnect) omitted.
Fitted-line endpoints not read; slide draws lines from stated totals.
